observation.command:
cd /workspace && python3 2>/dev/null || echo "no python3"; # use sed to blank SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN line in base.vars
sed -i 's/^SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=localhost$/SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=/' config/runtime/base.vars
grep -n "SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN" config/runtime/base.vars
echo "=== regenerate profile env + relaunch ==="
pkill -f 'sva-studio-react:serve' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'run-executor.js' 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
nohup pnpm exec tsx /tmp/launch-app2.mjs > /tmp/launch8.log 2>&1 & sleep 4; cat /tmp/launch8.log
